integrity: The proof supplies contractible attachment intersections, a determinant-one integral winding map, simply connectedness, Mayer-Vietoris, and homological Whitehead. The package contains a standard-library independent face/boundary verifier and its output. Bibliographic priority is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The result is nonequivariant and concerns all rotations of both orientations on n>=3 symbols; it does not classify arbitrary permutation sets or equivariant homology. Numerical checks through n=8 alone are not proofs for all n.
title: Dihedral permutation complexes are wedges of two-spheres
